title: advance_state_counter duplicated across store modules
description: There are three nearly-identical implementations of the two-statement counter increment pattern: advance_state_counter_in_tx (lib.rs, pub(crate)), advance_state_counter (MessageStore, private), and advance_state (ContactStore module-level fn). MessageStore::advance_state_counter re-implements the UPDATE+SELECT sequence from scratch instead of using advance_state_counter_in_tx. ChatStore::advance_state also re-implements it. All three should call advance_state_counter_in_tx inside an unchecked_transaction, or advance_state_counter_in_tx should become the single call site and the duplicates removed.
